maddeler.e:
يستجوبوا (form X)
# يَسْتَجْوِبُوا (yastajwibū) /jas.tad͡ʒ.wi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# يُسْتَجْوَبُوا (yustajwabū) /jus.tad͡ʒ.wa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
